items.title: How a Treasury buyback tweak helped bitcoin surge 25% to nearly $80,000 in days
Washington Goes All-In on Crypto: Trump Pushes Clarity, SEC Rules, and CFTC Warnings
items.summary: Trump urged executives to pass a "fair version" of the Clarity Act, the CFTC warned it would write its own rules if the bill stalls, and the SEC abruptly advanced its first crypto fundraising framework.

items.title: Morning Minute: CFTC Will Give Crypto Clarity If Congress Won’t
items.summary: Meanwhile crypto majors and alts continue to soar, with BTC nearing $80k and alts like Pump and ZEC putting up big candles.
